ruleset.name: Spring Cloud Function Modernization Rules
ruleset.description: Rules to encourage modern Java 17+ syntax conventions

rule.name: AvoidRawTypesForCollections
rule.message: Consider using parameterized types instead of raw types for collections (e.g., List<Object>). Suppress with @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidRawTypesForCollections") if intentional.
rule.description: Encourages the use of generics over raw types for standard collections to ensure type safety. Class literals, nested generic types (e.g., Map.Entry), instanceof checks and casts are excluded as they are not raw type usage in the sense of this rule.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: PreferPatternMatchingForInstanceof
rule.message: Consider using Java 16+ pattern matching for 'instanceof' to avoid explicit casting.
rule.description: Identifies 'instanceof' checks followed by an explicit cast of the same expression to the same type within the if-block, which can be simplified using pattern matching.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: SimplifyLambdaBlock
rule.message: Consider simplifying this single-statement lambda block. Braces and 'return' might be redundant.
rule.description: Lambdas with a single statement in their block can often be simplified to expression lambdas or method references.

rule.name: ConsiderUsingRecord
rule.message: Consider converting this private static class to a Java 16+ Record, as it appears to be an immutable data carrier.
rule.description: Identifies private static classes with only final fields, which are good candidates for Java Records.
